evidence_window.before_context: The old battery set could no longer sustain repeated enrollment attempts; no independently observed low icon or cloud battery value was retained.
evidence_window.after_context: A fresh alkaline set was installed before the successful attempts beginning at the boundary.

paired_link_selector_05.interpretation: Both offsets are already crossed against zone selection and watering countdown; neither is a battery candidate.

conclusions: No ordinary paired-link, startup, or factory field is presently supported as HTV405 battery state.

The diagnostic family changed across the battery replacement, but the same offsets changed again after bounded watering while the fresh batteries were unchanged. Those offsets encode dynamic device/session data and cannot be promoted as battery.
The cloud catalog's port-0 STA_BAT declaration establishes the semantic feature but does not locate it in the RF frame.

A controlled normal-to-low voltage transition with an independently observed LCD or app state is still required. Until then Home Assistant must report HTV405 battery as unavailable rather than invent a percentage.
